source: NZM PC installation Content/Paks (80 base archives). Saved patch archives were indexed but are not merged into these exports.
validation_scope: PNG decode and highest-available mip dimensions; ActorX points, faces, bones and every nonzero weight/index compared with decoded source. No Unreal Editor import, animation or visual validation.
normal_map_policy: BC5 R/G retained, Z reconstructed; no green-channel or image-axis flip. These PNG files are not glTF baked normals.
